Client.title: Client
Client.description: Represents a VIP client participating in a driver's loyalty program

id.description: Unique client document ID (driverId_phone or legacy phone)

driverId.description: UID of the driver who owns this client record

passengerUid.description: UID of the passenger account that registered the ride

lastQrCodeId.description: Most recent single-use QR Code ID consumed for scoring

phone.description: Client normalized BR phone number (DDD + 8/9 digits)

points.description: Current active loyalty points (0-9, resets after 10)

rewardsAvailable.description: Number of free rides earned and currently available to claim

rewardsRedeemed.description: Number of free rides that have already been redeemed

isArchived.description: Whether the client has been archived from the active list

createdAt.description: Timestamp when client was first registered

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last client update or ride

QrCode.title: QrCode
QrCode.description: Single-use QR code generated by a driver for ride confirmation

driverId.description: UID of the driver who generated the QR code

status.description: Current status of the QR code

usedByPhone.description: Phone number of client who used the QR code

usedByName.description: Name of client who used the QR code

usedAt.description: Timestamp when the code was claimed

Ride.title: Ride
Ride.description: Recorded ride history entry linked to a consumed single-use QR code

qrCodeId.description: QR Code ID consumed for this ride

Reward.title: Reward
Reward.description: Free ride reward lifecycle record (AVAILABLE upon 10 points -> REDEEMED upon driver confirmation)

driverId.description: Driver UID who owns/redeems the reward

qrCodeId.description: Single-use QR code ID whose 10th point unlocked this reward

/clients/{clientId}.description: Driver-isolated VIP clients, loyalty point balances, and archive flags

/qrcodes/{codeId}.description: Single-use dynamic QR codes (15-min validity) generated by drivers

/rides/{rideId}.description: Audit log of registered trips tied to single-use QR codes

/rewards/{rewardId}.description: Log of available rewards and free city ride redemptions
